name: Zarhold
summary: Zarhold is a free-to-play online role-playing game played in a web browser, in which combat takes the form of turn-based card duels. Each player creates a persistent hero from 10 classes and 11 races across three factions and levels it from 1 to 60 across 26 zones with 312 quests. Instead of an ability bar, the hero holds a hand of cards paid for with crystals that grow by one per turn up to ten; each class also has a Class Power and each race a racial ability. PvE content includes 23 dungeons for groups of three and 6 raids and 3 world bosses for groups of five, with a heroic difficulty and class tier sets at the maximum level. PvP includes a 1v1, 2v2, 3v3 and 5v5 arena with separate ratings, a 5v5 battleground and duels. The game also features 12 professions, an auction house, mail, guilds and parties in which all members act simultaneously. Computer-controlled "world residents" fill free slots in groups and arena queues. The game is available in English and Russian on desktop and mobile browsers and on VK Play.
